name: Holiday Shopping
source:
Holiday Shopping is a short winter VN, and a somewhat-indirect-prequel to the title Cemetery Mary. 
This visual novel follows the main character as they are called upon to help others during the holiday season. 

[Edited from [url=https://arcadekitten.itch.io/holiday-shopping]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Holiday Shopping》是一部以冬日为背景的短篇视觉小说，也算是《玛丽公墓》的一部间接前传。
故事围绕主角在节日期间应邀帮助他人展开。

[编译自[url=https://arcadekitten.itch.io/holiday-shopping]itch.io[/url]]
